system.name: BIRD-INTERACT
system.one_liner: A text-to-SQL benchmark that turns single-turn tasks into multi-turn interactions with a function-driven user simulator and an executable database environment.

content.variant_note: a narrow configuration column (task, cast, database) beside a framed transcript of six numbered user-system interactions
content.argues: Real text-to-SQL work needs clarification of ambiguous requests, knowledge lookup, error feedback and follow-up subtasks, so evaluation must replay a whole interaction rather than one query.
content.subject: One artifact-ranking task with two subtasks, hidden ambiguities and a masked knowledge-base entry, followed through six interactions between user simulator, system and database.

lessons.what_to_learn: For an interactive benchmark, put a narrow setting column (task, hidden intent, cast, database) next to a framed transcript of numbered interactions, each turn an avatar bubble with a move tag; red text follows the ambiguity from spec to dialogue.
lessons.suits: Multi-turn or agentic benchmarks (SQL, tool use, dialogue) where the point is the sequence of clarifications, actions and feedback on one concrete task.

summary: BIRD-INTERACT is a text-to-SQL benchmark that converts single-turn LiveSQLBench tasks into multi-turn interactions in which the evaluated system talks to a function-driven user simulator and an executable database environment. Figure 1 puts a narrow configuration column on the left (user task with two subtasks, annotated ambiguities with their real intentions, the User Simulator, System and DB Environment stack with dashed Actions and Observations arrows, DB metadata and a knowledge base whose AVS entry is masked) beside a framed User-Agent Interaction Example. That panel replays six numbered interactions as avatar speech bubbles tagged Ask, Clarify, Submit and feedback, with real SQL blocks and test-case ticks. Red text follows the ambiguity through the whole figure. It is a dense double-column figure in 3-6 pt type.
summary_zh: BIRD-INTERACT把单轮text-to-SQL改成多轮交互评测。图1左栏给出任务、标注歧义、用户模拟器/系统/数据库环境及元数据和知识库，右栏用头像气泡复现六轮交互与SQL代码、测试结果，红字贯穿歧义。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The preview PNG shows serif fallback for some titles; the SVG digest names Calibri, Lato-Italic and Consolas. Direction of the Actions and Observations arrows is read from the arrowheads in the preview (actions leave the system, observations return). The pale red and green bands (#ffe0dc, #daf2d0) are assumed to be highlight bands behind SQL fragments of the AVS formula. The dashed test-code callout is not joined by leader lines.
